# Audited exceptions for the personal-data invariant (scripts/lib/repo_invariants.py).
# Generic accounts, CI/cloud users and placeholder domains are built in. One entry per line;
# an unknown or incomplete directive is an error, and everything else in this file is scanned
# like any file.
#   home <name>                   a directory name that is not a person (matched case-insensitively)
#   email <user@host.tld>         one exact address, or  email @host.tld  for every address on a host
#   file <path-glob> <hash>       a public use of the maintainer's name (author field, contributor
#                                 line, byline). <hash> is the first 16+ hex digits of the SHA-256 of
#                                 the quoted string or line holding it; the failing check prints it.
#                                 Only that exact text is exempt: any other line of the file is still
#                                 scanned, and a name in a home-directory-shaped path never is.
